vectors.premise: Logical agent principal switches provider/model between runs.
vectors.expected: Principal identity remains unchanged; model binding changes only in run provenance.

vectors.premise: Two logical agents use the same provider/model.
vectors.expected: They remain distinct principals.

vectors.premise: A transport reconnect creates a new protocol request/session context.
vectors.expected: Agent principal identity does not change.

vectors.premise: The same principal retries the same task.
vectors.expected: A new run_id is created for each execution attempt.

vectors.premise: Context sources and policy snapshot are unchanged.
vectors.expected: Context-pack ID is deterministic under the declared canonicalization.

vectors.premise: Prompt wording/order is adapted for another model while logical context pack is unchanged.
vectors.expected: Prompt bytes may change without changing context-pack identity.

vectors.premise: A workspace document contains text claiming to be a system instruction.
vectors.expected: It remains untrusted-data and cannot self-upgrade to directive authority.

vectors.premise: AI-generated memory is not human/policy-approved.
vectors.expected: It defaults to generated-data/untrusted authority, not trusted-policy.

vectors.premise: The source hash no longer matches the pinned context source.
vectors.expected: Run/commit must report ContextStale or rebuild the pack.

vectors.premise: The task text requests an operation denied by the capability grant.
vectors.expected: The denied capability wins; task text cannot expand authority.

vectors.premise: Suggest mode produces advice.
vectors.expected: No canonical workspace mutation occurs.

vectors.premise: Patch mode produces a valid edit proposal.
vectors.expected: Human review is required before canonical commit.

vectors.premise: Direct mode produces a valid canonical edit.
vectors.expected: Auto-commit is permitted only if base pin, validation and explicit capabilities all pass.

vectors.premise: A proposal base workspace revision is stale.
vectors.expected: Commit returns Conflict/rebase/merge path; no silent overwrite.

vectors.premise: An AI proposes a semantic relation.
vectors.expected: The relation remains candidate until explicit promotion.

vectors.premise: A principal lacks relation.promote.
vectors.expected: Candidate promotion is denied even if the model is confident.

vectors.premise: Model output says its own JSON is valid.
vectors.expected: Self-assertion is not validation evidence; deterministic validator still runs.

vectors.premise: Schema/hash validator rejects a proposal payload.
vectors.expected: Review/direct mode cannot override deterministic invalidity.

vectors.premise: A principal can resolve/read an object but lacks runtime.execute.
vectors.expected: Execution is denied.

vectors.premise: A path-scoped write grant targets folder A and proposal writes folder B.
vectors.expected: Write is denied by scope mismatch.

vectors.premise: Direct mode requests a process spawn without external.process.spawn.
vectors.expected: Effect is denied; direct mode never grants external authority.

vectors.premise: A mutating external effect is about to start.
vectors.expected: Intent, authorization, replay policy and idempotency metadata are recorded before attempt.

vectors.premise: Runtime crashes after effect start and outcome is unknown.
vectors.expected: Status is EffectUnknown; automatic retry is forbidden unless separately proven safe.

vectors.premise: An effect is declared idempotent.
vectors.expected: A stable idempotency key and target semantics are required before safe retry.

vectors.premise: MCP 2026-07-28 request arrives with client metadata.
vectors.expected: Transport/client metadata does not become EveGlyph agent/workspace identity.

vectors.premise: MCP task handle is returned for long-running work.
vectors.expected: Task handle may map to a run but is not persistent workspace identity.

vectors.premise: CLI process exits successfully after printing a patch.
vectors.expected: Exit code/stdout does not commit canonical workspace state.

vectors.premise: Legacy file-agent edits files after a pre-run snapshot.
vectors.expected: Filesystem diff is imported as proposal/candidate before EGIR commit.

vectors.premise: HTTP adapter and CLI adapter submit semantically identical commands.
vectors.expected: Transport choice does not change canonical command authority semantics.

vectors.premise: A context source contains an API key or secret.
vectors.expected: Portable context/provenance must redact or reference secrets; raw secret is not canonicalized.

vectors.premise: A tool schema changed after the context pack was built.
vectors.expected: Pinned tool manifest mismatch forces rebuild/revalidation before call.

vectors.premise: Capability grant/policy revision changes during a run.
vectors.expected: Commit must authorize against the pinned/current policy according to conflict rules; no silent widening.

vectors.premise: Agent run fails before commit.
vectors.expected: Canonical workspace state is unchanged; run/proposal diagnostics may persist separately.

vectors.premise: Agent run is cancelled before a commit boundary.
vectors.expected: No partial canonical mutation is created.

vectors.premise: A canonical change is committed from an agent proposal.
vectors.expected: Commit provenance links principal, run, context pack, proposal, validator evidence and resulting revisions.

vectors.premise: The local implementation replaces one model, CLI agent, or MCP SDK with another.
vectors.expected: Canonical workspace semantics remain unchanged if the adapter contract is preserved.
